checks.observed: The exact frozen command passed independently with 23 tests, 0 failures, and 0 errors after an initial sandbox-only temporary-directory denial was reproduced and isolated. Nominal coverage is meaningful, but it omits the adversarial category and digest cases reported elsewhere.

The local Flask UI automatically produced the six-case 2/1/3 run. Operating the Case 02 preset changed 1,000 MWh to 1,000 kWh, normalized activity 1,000,000 to 1,000 kWh, recomputed emissions 177 to 0.177 tCO2e, input/run hash, and RECONCILED to MISMATCH while source/factor/engine hashes stayed stable.

All four prescribed fail-closed cases returned the expected REVIEW_REQUIRED reason codes with no computed result. An added incompatible activity-category check failed closedness: diesel plus the electricity factor returned RECONCILED. A malformed supplied source digest was also accepted into a RECONCILED result.

Independent default and changed executions are byte-identical to committed JSON/CSV evidence, and per-result fields agree. The CSV contains no runId column, so the frozen requirement to compare run identity across both exports is unmet.

Exactly three Letter pages rendered at 150 DPI and were independently inspected. All pages are readable and unclipped with no overlaps; page 1 shows the actual default result, page 2 shows the real factor-vintage correction and implemented code, and page 3 shows 2/1/3 proof, the unit change, tests, limitations, and two link annotations.

The 2/1/3 benchmark, unit-change values, source/workbook hashes, factor rows, and stated limitations trace correctly. However, the claim that incompatible factor evidence is refused is contradicted by the RECONCILED category-conflict run, and the Manifest incorrectly says no stable candidate or validator dispatch exists.

Committed source/privacy scope, ignored raw-source handling, local-only routes, and role separation were confirmed. The malformed-digest acceptance violates the traceability boundary, the activity-category conflict violates exact compatible-factor resolution, and a release-stage gate cannot pass while this FAIL report has unresolved findings.
